design.name: 旗鼓校尉
design.brief: The legion's banner-and-drum officer, the support: an officer in ornate red-and-bronze lamellar with a plumed helmet and a grinning iron mask, a large red war drum strapped on his back with a tall triangular war banner on a pole rising behind it, cyan light glowing from the drum skin (weak spot: the drum on his back). Beating the drum rallies the troops. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four fingers.
design.weapon: two drumsticks raised over his shoulder to beat the war drum on his back, the banner streaming
design.style_note: Style target: the enemies of Gunfire Reborn — a readable military unit roster where every troop type is told apart at 30 m by silhouette and weapon. Strongly stylized, chunky and exaggerated: big helmets and pauldrons, oversized hands and weapons, compact sturdy bodies, faces hidden behind iron masks with two glowing cyan eye slits, bold saturated colour blocks (lacquer red, dark iron, bronze, white fur, cyan glow), clean bevelled forms, armour plates as a few big shapes, no tiny detail noise. Menacing and cool, not cute.
